name: @quifox/agent-plugin-steering
description: Concurrent input batching and run steering for Agent Core

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @quifox/agent-core build && pnpm --filter @quifox/agent-plugin-session build && pnpm --filter @quifox/agent-plugin-interrupt build && tsc -p tsconfig.json
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @quifox/agent-core build && pnpm --filter @quifox/agent-plugin-session build && pnpm --filter @quifox/agent-plugin-interrupt build && pnpm --filter @quifox/agent-plugin-checkpoint build && pnpm --filter @quifox/agent-plugin-events build && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --noEmit --pretty false
scripts.check: pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
